theme: An open day in St. Pete, the girls home for Halloween eve.
greeting: No meetings on the calendar today, Dan — the day is genuinely yours. The only things pulling at you are a couple of holiday-travel bookings that have drifted well past due on the board.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board since Sep 14 and still open. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — thin inventory, holiday pricing, and it sells out. Book a refundable one now and adjust dates later; this is the one overdue item with a real daily cost.

needsAttention.title: December break is still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: p2 on the board — the decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15) dates have both passed. Six people over the holidays (Dec 13 to Jan 2) is the thinnest inventory of the year. Pick domestic vs. international and lock something this week.

flagged.title: Two new LinkedIn role alerts
flagged.detail: Estee Lauder — Executive Director, Corporate Strategy; and a Managing Partner opening at Synergy Management Group. Both automated alerts, worth a glance.

flagged.title: CMP electric bill ready (Maine)
flagged.detail: Central Maine Power bill posted, with an automatic payment already scheduled — no action needed unless you want to review it.

inbox.noise: Heavy promo morning — Hilton, Expedia, Amtrak, Indochino, Harry & David, plus the usual St. Pete and Press Herald newsletters.

resolved: ICGN Plenary 7 panel is locked for next week in Toronto — Jane Ambachtsheer (BNP Paribas) and Andy Howard (Schroders) both signed off on your outline, and Claudia registered your comp place.

recipe.title: Warm beet soup
recipe.why: Halloween eve in St. Pete with a full house — a deep-ruby pot of beets you can leave to simmer while the girls sort out their costumes, earthy and sweet at the very peak of the season.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Close out the Pathfinder drive (Portland to St Pete)
Portland house order — king bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: No meetings on the books at all — the clear morning is the best stretch for anything that needs real focus.
The day stays open; the girls are home, so it can flex around them and the few overdue decisions.
A quiet close, with Halloween and the kids filling tomorrow.
